semantics: Bindings derived from exact firmware disassembly and public NXP source comparison. One v6 hardware run on p67glt 3.201.026 demonstrated the synthetic NFC-to-BLE-to-Pixel-to-BLE-to-NFC path, accepted route setup and verified STOPPED cleanup; this is not validation of every binding or concurrency case. Calls use Thumb execution alias; fingerprint reads use XIP data alias. No SE/default technology routing API is called.

raw_hook.read_slot: HAL open saves r1 to 0x200eaab0; forwarding wrapper 0x2c64faa8 loads that slot and blx calls it with unmodified (uint16 length,uint8 *packet). Original callback0x2c65af1c copies packet into stack task queue.

queued_command.path: 0x2c650ed8 copies bytes and cb into event0x11a; action0x2c650740 repackages BT_HDR; internal0x2c65d724 marks layer_specific2 and cb at+8; queue0x2c65b9a8 stores callback at NFC_CB+0x140 when that message is sent; response0x2c65ab98 invokes cb(event=oid|0x40,len,fullNCIpacket), clears slot, updates command window.

queued_response.path: 0x2c650dcc copies bytes into event0x10c; action0x2c650874 requires discovery state4 or5, calls NFC_SendData with connid0 for listen state5. API returns enqueue status, not RF delivery acknowledgement.

experiment.runtime_hooks: Only compare-exchange HAL data callback RAM slot. Original chain retained for all management and unrelated data. Module must remain resident until reboot.

hardware_validation.observed: GET/SET/verification reached READY; SELECT returned 9000; a fresh synthetic challenge matched BLE request/response and NFC response; STOP and subsequent QUERY reported STOPPED.
hardware_validation.scope_limit: One observed run on this exact device and firmware, not a repeatability, timing-distribution, terminal, payment, or Mir Pay test.

recovery.baseline: Retain entire pre-add baseline and intended baseline+test table. Normal cleanup snapshots CURRENT table, removes exact own route and preserves all other TLVs. Original baseline multiset must remain present.
recovery.partial_set: If original entries disappeared but every current entry belongs to our intended table, restore retained baseline and GET verify. If unknown/concurrent entries coexist with missing originals, remain RECOVERY without writing.
recovery.serialization: Dry-run all SET chunks before mutation. Per-request NFA callback required for response; raw same-opcode responses do not complete request. Accepted STOP and raw commands remain owned across timeout until completion.
recovery.stop: Asynchronous. A clean flag requires verified route cleanup, RF discovery restart and callback restore. can_unload is a cleanup state helper only; root module never unloads.

limitations: Runtime INFO advertised NCI 2.0, NXP family, AID support and LMRT 1030; one v6 synthetic physical APDU run passed (app elapsed 396.5 ms). Exact NFC chip/firmware identity and wider compatibility remain unestablished.

No proven stock-stack routing transaction lock. A simultaneous stock routing update between snapshot and SET can race this experiment. GET notification protocol has no transaction ID. Do not treat mocks or callback matching as proving global isolation.
Controller multi-chunk SET atomicity is unknown. Partial writes are detected/restored only under the documented unambiguous baseline subset condition; ambiguous outcomes remain RECOVERY.
Stock RF discovery must already be enabled and idle/discovering. No initialization, reset, persistence, default technology diversion, SE access, payment AIDs or Mir Pay calls are implemented.

First SELECT must fit a single NCI DATA packet; subsequent own APDUs may fragment. Limits CAPDU261/RAPDU258 bytes. No ISO-DEP WTX implementation; one complete synthetic run was measured, while real BLE timing distribution, sleep behavior and payment-terminal deadlines remain untested.
Fingerprints identify exact compiled entrypoints in the provided image, not a formal vendor ABI contract. Full firmware and module context checks are additionally performed by watchface loader.

diagnostics.retained: nfc_probe_diagnostic() remains across STOP until a new START passes preflight/discovery gates. Command failure status uses the same stable buffer, including after successful automatic RF restart.
diagnostics.format: NFC_REJECT or NFC_BAD_RSP; op=expectedOID, st=controller status or -- for unaccepted shape, ev=callback event, n=full callback length, cb=up to8 leading bytes, raw=independent4-byte HAL management RSP prefix or -, v=runtime NCI version, d=route-dirty flag at error. Hex is uppercase; n is decimal. Max121bytes plus ERROR: <=127.
diagnostics.concurrency: Callback fields are bounded writes before release publication of completion; poll acquires completion and formats. One callback belongs to each pending NFA command; no next command is submitted before consumption. Raw witness is a single atomic32-bit word, cleared per command; it is never accepted as ownership/correlation.
diagnostics.version_evidence: 0x2c65b200 getter reads base0x200eb5f4+0x1f8. 0x2c65c9a4/c9a6 copy CORE_RESET_NTF payload+2 into same byte; 0x2c65ca0c/ca10 assign legacy0x10. Getter first24bytes, including base literal, are now in preflight fingerprints. Read happens once after successful fingerprint/callback/stack/discovery gates.
diagnostics.unchanged: NFC packet acceptance predicate, route snapshot validation, no SET without full GET snapshot, timeout/cleanup ownership and RF forwarding remain unchanged. Diagnostic capture is not a controller command.

cached_info.API: nfc_probe_info(), same control thread as all public probe APIs. Separate stable <=121-byte ASCII buffer; never touches retained response diagnostic.
cached_info.gates: Full existing fingerprint, original HAL slots and enabled-stack preflight, then NCI version must be exactly 0x20. No cache read on preflight failure; no feature/LMRT/ctrl/chip read for other NCI versions. Own active hook also returns unavailable. No NFC command, discovery stop/start, hook or route mutation.
cached_info.parser: nfc_enabled 0x2c65b2fc: literal at0x2c65b504 supplies nfc_cb=0x200eb5f4. 0x65b37c stores 32-bit LE features at+c0; 0x65b384 stores uint16 maxLMRT at+c4; 0x65b390 stores uint8 max control payload at+c7. r8 points to CORE_INIT_RSP payload after status. These instructions/base literal are separately fingerprinted.
cached_info.feature_bits: NCI2 NFCC Features second octet: bit0 reserved, bit1 technology, bit2 protocol, bit3 AID, bit4 system-code, bit5 APDU-pattern, bit6 forced-NFCEE. The reported aid=(features>>11)&1 is advertised AID routing support only, not proof of DH card emulation or an accepted route.
cached_info.chip: Pure getter0x2c6425f0 reads byte0x200b04b5. Selection0x642c7e..0x642ca6 stores 0 for NXP,1 for THN31; unknown path0x642ac6..0x642ad6 stores FF. Family0 cannot distinguish SN100 from SN110. Getter+literal fingerprinted; getter itself is not called.
cached_info.format: cached v=20 chip=00 feat=XXXXXXXX aid=1 lmrt=65535 ctrl=255, or unavailable gate=<preflight code>, or cached v=XX unavailable: unsupported NCI layout. Values are startup cache, not a live controller query.
cached_info.observed_v6: cached v=20 chip=00 feat=00063E1A aid=1 lmrt=1030 ctrl=255; see ../evidence/pixel-gatt-v6-observation.json. This startup cache does not establish an exact NFCC model.
